To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the parts using the wax-based binder system containing LDPE and HDPE as backbone binders exhibited the best molding, debinding and sintering performances.

the backbone binders in wax-based binder systems have a significant influence on the molding, solvent debinding, and thermal debinding behaviors, and the parts containing LDPE/HDPE as backbone binders exhibited a better sintered microstructure, and thus higher mechanical properties.
the feedstocks containing multi-polymers exhibited a more homogeneous structure, and the backbone binder with a higher crystallinity and melting point is more suitable for zirconia parts.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of different backbone binder systems on the properties of zirconia ceramics prepared by CIM.
the effects of different backbone bindes on the characteristics of the zirconia parts prepared by CIM.
the effect of different backbone polymers on the molding characteristics of zirconium oxide parts by CIM.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the backbone binder plays a significant role on the characteristics of the zirconia parts, and the feedstock with LDPE and HDPE as backbone binders is more promising for the preparation of zirconia components with good performance.
the backbone binders have significant effects on the molding, de-binding, and sintered characteristics of zirconium parts using wax-based system via CIM.
the feedstocks using mono-polymer components are more appropriate for the wax-based binder system, while multi-polymer feedstock would be a better choice for the polymer-based binder system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the backbone binders with low melting temperature and good compatibility with the other binders were beneficial to the molding, debindind and sintering of zirconia ceramic parts.

the backbone binders play a significant role in the molding, debidding, and sinterability of zirconia ceramics, and the feedstock with LDPE or HDPE as the backbone binder would be a good choice to prepare high performance zirconia parts via CIM.

the backbone binder plays an important role in the wax-based binder system, and the feedstock using LDPE and HDPE as backbone binders would be a good candidate in the wax-based system for the production of zirconia ceramics via CIM.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the selection of backbone binders is a critical issue to obtain the desired properties in the wax-based binder system for zirconia parts via CIM.
the backbone binder has a significant effect on the molding, sintering behaviors and mechanical properties of the zirconia parts.
it is possible to obtain high-performance zirconia parts with different backbone binders in a wax-based binder system.
